title: Kerala private bus operators announce indefinite strike from November 3

tea.why: Private bus operators protest against financial losses and revenue impact caused by the state-run KSRTC Priyadarshini free travel scheme.
tea.want: Compensation for losses linked to the Priyadarshini scheme and implementation of special commission recommendations for the private bus sector.
tea.changed: Oct 27: Private bus owners held a meeting in Palakkad and announced an indefinite strike starting November 3.

summary: Private bus operators across Kerala have announced an indefinite strike set to begin on November 3, 2026. The decision was finalized during a joint meeting of private bus owners held in Palakkad, organized by a joint committee representing six bus owners' associations including the Kerala Bus Transport Association, All Kerala Bus Operators Forum, All Kerala Bus Operators Organization, Kerala Private Bus Operators Association, and Kerala Bus Operators Coordination Committee. Operators claim that the introduction of the KSRTC Priyadarshini scheme, offering free travel for women and transgender persons, has caused severe revenue losses to the private sector and placed financial pressure on workers. They also accused the government of failing to implement recommendations submitted by a special commission appointed on September 2 and criticized Transport Minister C P John for operating competitive state-run services funded through various contributions. According to reports, discussions held with the Transport Minister on October 10 failed to yield a resolution.
demands: Compensation for losses linked to the Priyadarshini scheme
Implementation of recommendations submitted by the special commission
Action to address the financial difficulties faced by private bus employees
response: According to the sources, discussions with Transport Minister C P John on October 10 failed to yield a favourable outcome, and operators claimed the government has failed to act on recommendations or address their demands.

updates.text: Organisers informed the government about the proposed strike.
Private bus owners held a joint meeting in Palakkad and announced an indefinite strike starting November 3.
